metadata.title: PSImageConverter
metadata.description: Cross-platform PowerShell 7 module for converting images such as HEIC/HEIF photos to JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and more, powered by Magick.NET; writes HEIC with the HEVC encoder of the operating system. Pipeline-friendly; keeps the EXIF metadata in JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and JPEG XL output.

warnings: Gallery response exceeds its size limit.
